name: Kerakera-sei
source:
Hero attends a marginal boys school, hangs out with his friend Tamaki and likes to peep at top class girls school beauties in the neighborhood. And he gets an invitation to girls school cultural festival from his bitter enemy, glasses girl Kumiko who managed to stop the peeping every time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-october-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公萩原翔就读于一所末流男校，平日和朋友玉置康介混在一起，还喜欢偷看附近名门女校的美少女。他每次偷窥都会被戴眼镜的宿敌菅野久美子阻止，没想到这一次，久美子竟邀请他参加女校的文化祭。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-october-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
